en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  narrates  that  the  Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “Surely an angel descends carrying a scroll in the beginning of day and night and writes the deeds of men. Hence one should do good deeds in the beginning of day and night. God willing, you will be forgiven during the other times also if Allah wills, because Allah, the Mighty and   Sublime   says:   ‘Therefore   remember   Me,   I   will remember   you’. And   He   says:   ‘and   certainly   the remembrance of Allah is the greatest’.”
